alerts.message: CONVERGENCE ALERT: 3 vessels + 2 aircraft detected within 5nm radius of Strait of Hormuz. Elevated transit activity detected.

GDELT SIGNIFICANT EVENT: EU Summit on Energy Policy showing elevated media coverage (significance: 9.0/10).
FLIGHT ANOMALY: Military aircraft RECON42 deviation from filed flight plan detected. Current altitude: 45,000ft.
VESSEL UPDATE: EVER GIVEN now transiting Suez Canal. Speed reduced to 8.7kn, nominal transit parameters.
CONVERGENCE ALERT: 4 vessels converging on Bab-el-Mandeb strait. Naval vessel RED SEA GUARDIAN on intercept course.
ECONOMIC INDICATOR: Baltic Dry Index dropped 3.2% in past 24h. Current: 1,247 (down from 1,289).
NLP SIGNAL: 42 relevant communications intercepted in past hour. Keywords: 'maritime security', 'supply chain', 'energy'.
VESSEL POSITIONING: MAERSK TRIPOLI arrived London Gateway, now stationary. 8 other vessels in holding pattern.
GDELT CLUSTER: 3 related events detected within 100km of Brussels. Topic: Energy Policy. Tone: Neutral to Negative.
FLIGHT MONITOR: 7 anomalies detected in past 6 hours. All commercial flights, minor deviations, no immediate concern.
MULTI-SOURCE CONVERGENCE: Vessel + thermal + GDELT activity detected near Panama Canal. Possible incident investigation underway.
THERMAL WILDFIRE: High-intensity signature detected Amazon Basin. Intensity: 9.2, expanding. Monitoring for maritime smoke impact.
SYSTEM STATUS: All data feeds operational. 847 vessels tracked, 3,421 flights monitored, 89 thermal signatures active.
GDELT UPDATE: Maritime Security Exercise in Dubai showing elevated social media activity. Public awareness campaign confirmed.
